title: Statements and intelligence-presence controversy after the death of Quentin Deranque (Lyon)
description: Quentin Deranque, a young far-right (identitaire) activist, died on 14 February 2026 from a head injury sustained during a brawl in Lyon two days earlier, in which antifascist activists were involved. On 15 February 2026 Nuñez stated on television that 'the ultra-left was clearly at work' ('Manifestement, l'ultragauche était à la manoeuvre'). On 27 March 2026 BFM TV and Le Canard enchaîné reported that territorial intelligence (renseignement territorial) officers had been present at the scene and photographed activists before and after the brawl without witnessing the fight itself. La France insoumise (LFI) deputies challenged Nuñez over what they called a 'state scandal' and 'concealment of crucial information at the highest level of the state.' Nuñez defended the ministry's handling.
status: political/administrative controversy; criminal murder inquiry into the death is ongoing; no charges reported against the minister
key_facts: Quentin Deranque, a far-right identitaire activist, died 14 February 2026 after a head injury in a Lyon brawl
Nuñez said on 15 Feb 2026 that 'the ultra-left was clearly at work'
